boundary_rule: abs gap <1 STORY; 1 through 2 LEAN; >2 BET only if positive priced EV
opposite_rule: PASS_DISAGREE unless one confidence >=4 and other <3
same_side_rule: Use lower-confidence person's entered number; ties use smaller stake
missing_person: MISSED; no joint pick; retain blind entry privately
entries: First submission per person is final, so nobody can revise after revealing the other number
early: Monday 09:00 America/Los_Angeles quote snapshot; a market may lock only with both entries submitted before the capture window and joint BET gap >2
late: T80 quotes, T75 freeze; only entries received before T75; missing/late capture is MISSED
market_open_evidence: Scheduled Monday snapshot, not proof of bookmaker's first opening quote; POST_OPEN means after scheduled Monday cutoff
unsupported_sensors: UNKNOWN with reason; no proxy silently substituted
